package main
import (
 _ "embed"
 "fmt"
 "strings"
)
//go:embed version.record
var record string
func Version() string {
 const head="BIMERON.APPLE."
 const tail="CORE.VERSION/v1\x00"
 if len(record)<len(head)+len(tail)+4 { panic("truncated record") }
 if !strings.HasPrefix(record,head) || !strings.HasPrefix(record[len(head):],tail) { panic("invalid record prefix") }
 p:=len(head)+len(tail)
 n:=0
 for _,c:=range record[p:p+3] { if c<'0' || c>'9' { panic("invalid record length") }; n=n*10+int(c-'0') }
 if n<1 || n>128 || record[p+3]!=':' { panic("invalid record length") }
 end:=p+4+n
 if end>len(record) || record[end:]!="\x00END.APPLE.CORE.RECORD/v1\x00" { panic("invalid record frame") }
 return record[p+4:end]
}
func main(){fmt.Println(Version())}
